note: A Game About Digging A Hole Together revealed at the ID@Xbox x IGN Showcase (Xbox Wire recap 20 Oct 17:45Z): Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Game Pass on 4 Dec 2026; Mi'pu'mi Games, published by rokaplay Select and Shochiku (Steam 4018610). Template trailer. Footage: the official reveal trailer (Steam), 1080p, shots with the friends in frame; its own music from 21 s (no voices).

وتصدر في 4 ديسمبر على Xbox وPC
ضمن Game Pass من اليوم الأول
